scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.readdirSync('dist').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.html')&&f!=='designs').forEach(f=>{const fp=p.join('dist',f);if(fs.statSync(fp).isFile())fs.unlinkSync(fp);});console.log('postbuild: HTMLs estáticos removidos de dist/')"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name vclass
scripts.types:gen: npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id $env:SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF --schema public > src/types/database.ts
